## Instructions for the AI agent

Add File dropzone to this project exactly as specified here.

1. **Setup first.** Look for `ui/styles/kit.css` in the folder the `@/` import alias points to (`src/` in most Next.js apps, otherwise the project root). If it is missing, apply the one-time setup first: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/setup.md
2. **Components it uses.** File dropzone imports 2 other components. Install them first, in this order, skipping any already in `ui/components/`. Each doc lists its files; the download script below covers them too.
   - `field`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/field.md
   - `progress`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigMatrixLab/component-library/main/ai/components/progress.md
3. **Create the files.** Create every file under [Files](#files) at its exact path, with exactly the contents shown. If you can run shell commands, the download script below does this and the step before in one go.
4. **Register the CSS.** In `ui/styles/kit.css`, add these lines directly above the `@source` line, skipping any already there:

   ```css
   @import "./components/field.css";
   @import "./components/progress.css";
   @import "./components/file-dropzone.css";
   ```

5. **Use it.** `import { FileDropzone, describeAccept, fileKey, formatBytes, … } from '@/ui/components/file-dropzone';` See [Usage](#usage). Tell the user which files you created.

**Rules.** Copy every file verbatim: do not restyle, rename classes, reformat, "improve", convert to another styling approach (CSS modules, styled-components, inline styles) or add npm packages. React and Tailwind CSS v4 only. Keep `'use client'` lines where they are. If a file already exists with identical contents, leave it. Fetch this doc and the source files as raw text (for example with `curl`), not through a summarising web reader: the code must arrive character for character.

## Specification

### Component: FileDropzone

A drop target with a real file input behind it, validation with error rows, and a list of the picked files. It never uploads; the app listens to `onFilesChange` and reports progress through `fileStatus`.

#### Anatomy
```
<div class="ui-file-dropzone">
  <div class="ui-file-dropzone-zone [ui-file-dropzone-compact]" role="button" tabindex="0"
       aria-labelledby=title aria-describedby=rules(+field) data-dragging data-disabled data-invalid>
    <span class="ui-file-dropzone-icon" aria-hidden>icon</span>
    <span class="ui-file-dropzone-text">
      <span class="ui-file-dropzone-title">Click to upload (link style) or drag and drop</span>
      <span class="ui-file-dropzone-rules">PDF, DOCX or XLSX · up to 10 MB each · max 5 files</span>
    </span>
  </div>
  <input type="file" class="ui-file-dropzone-input" tabindex="-1" aria-hidden="true">   sibling of the zone, visually hidden
  <ul class="ui-file-errors" role="alert"><li class="ui-file-error">alert icon, message, dismiss button</li></ul>
  <ul class="ui-file-list" aria-label="Selected files">
    <li class="ui-file-row" data-status="idle|uploading|success|error">
      <span class="ui-file-row-thumb"><img> | file / image icon</span>
      <span class="ui-file-row-body">name · meta (size, %, Uploaded, error text) · Progress (sm) while uploading · extra</span>
      status icon (success / error) · <button class="ui-file-row-remove" aria-label="Remove {name}">
    </li>
  </ul>
</div>
```

#### Props
- `value` / `defaultValue` (`File[]`), `onFilesChange(files)`, `onReject(rejections)` where a rejection is `{ file, code: 'invalid-type' | 'too-large' | 'too-many', message }`.
- `accept` (input syntax: `.ext`, `type/*`, `type/sub`), `multiple` (default false: a new valid pick replaces the file; an invalid pick keeps the old one), `maxSize` (bytes), `maxFiles`, `disabled`, `name` (mirrors the list into the real input with `DataTransfer` so forms submit it).
- `title`, `rules` (default built from accept / maxSize / maxFiles; `null` hides), `icon` (default `upload`), `variant` `default | compact`, `children` (replaces the target content), `showList`, `previews`, `fileStatus(file) → { status?, progress?, message? }`, `renderFileExtra(file)`, `removeLabel(file)`, `zoneClassName`.
- Inside a Field: `useFieldControl` — the id goes on the hidden input (so the Label opens the picker); describedby and disabled apply to the target.
- Helpers (`file-utils.ts`): `formatBytes`, `matchesAccept`, `describeAccept`, `validateFiles`, `fileKey` (`name:size:lastModified`).

#### Behaviour
- Click, Enter or Space (when the zone itself is focused) calls `input.click()`. The input is a sibling, never inside the zone, so its click cannot re-enter the handler.
- Drag: only when `dataTransfer.types` includes `Files`. `dragenter` / `dragleave` are counted so child elements do not flicker; `data-dragging` is set while over; `drop` clears it and validates `dataTransfer.files`. Disabled: `dropEffect = none`, nothing is added.
- Validation per file in order: type, size, then count; files already in the list are skipped; overflow past the limit is reported once ("3 files were not added. The limit is 5 files."). Messages name the file and the rule ("report.exe isn't an accepted file type. Use PDF, DOCX or XLSX.", "scan.pdf is 12 MB. The limit is 10 MB.").
- Errors are replaced by the next pick, cleared on remove, and individually dismissible.
- Image thumbnails use `URL.createObjectURL`, revoked on change and unmount.
- Removing a file moves focus to the target.

#### Visual rules
- Target: 1.5px dashed `--ui-border-strong`, radius lg, bg `--ui-surface-muted` 45%, min height 9rem, padding 24 / 20px, centred column, gap 12px. Hover (fine pointer): border mixes toward foreground, bg 80%. Focus-visible: 3px ring at 45% and ring-coloured border. Dragging: border `--ui-primary`, bg primary 7%, `scale(1.01)`; the 40px icon circle turns primary 14% / `--ui-primary-text` and lifts 2px. Invalid: destructive border. Disabled: opacity .5.
- Title 14px / 500, link part `--ui-primary-text` underlined; rules 13px `--ui-muted-foreground`. Compact: a row, left-aligned, no min height, padding 14 / 16px.
- Error row: destructive 8% bg, 24% border, `--ui-destructive-text`, radius md, 13px.
- File row: 1px `--ui-border`, radius lg, `--ui-surface`, padding 10 / 8 / 10 / 10px, gap 12px. Thumb 40px square, radius md, `--ui-surface-muted`, image `object-fit: cover`. Name 14px / 500 truncated; meta 12px muted, destructive text on error. Success icon `--ui-success-text`; error row border mixes destructive 40%. Remove button 32px (44px on coarse pointers), muted, hover `--ui-accent`.

#### Motion
- Zone and icon: transform on `--ui-spring-snappy`; colours 150ms. Rows and errors `ui-rise-in`. Progress glides (Progress component). Reduced motion drops movement.

#### Accessibility
- The target is a button named by the title and described by the rules. Real input is `aria-hidden` with `tabindex="-1"`.
- Errors `role="alert"`; progress bars named "Uploading {name}"; remove buttons name the file.
- Everything drag and drop does is available with the keyboard and the picker.

#### Acceptance checks
- Choosing files through the input lists them with name and size; images get a thumbnail `img`.
- A wrong type, an oversized file and the overflow each produce one error row naming the rule; valid files in the same pick are still added.
- Single mode replaces the file.
- Dropping files (DataTransfer) adds them and sets `data-dragging` during dragover.
- Enter on the focused target opens the picker; remove returns focus to the target.
- `fileStatus` progress shows a progress bar with matching `aria-valuenow`.
- No axe violations in light and dark.

Paths are relative to the folder the `@/` alias points to. The folder keeps the library's own layout, so the relative imports inside the files work unchanged. Files of the components it uses are in their own docs (see Instructions).

### `ui/components/file-dropzone/file-dropzone.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import {
  forwardRef,
  useEffect,
  useId,
  useRef,
  useState,
  type ChangeEvent,
  type DragEvent,
  type HTMLAttributes,
  type KeyboardEvent,
  type ReactNode,
} from 'react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { useControllableState } from '../../hooks/use-controllable-state';
import { Icon, type IconName } from '../../icons/icon';
import { useFieldControl } from '../field/field-context';
import { FileRow } from './file-row';
import { describeAccept, formatBytes, validateFiles, fileKey, type FileRejection } from './file-utils';
import type { FileStatusInfo } from './types';

export interface FileDropzoneProps
  extends Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, 'defaultValue' | 'onChange' | 'title'> {
  /** Controlled list of files. */
  value?: File[];
  /** Initial files when uncontrolled. */
  defaultValue?: File[];
  /** Called with the full list whenever a file is added or removed. */
  onFilesChange?: (files: File[]) => void;
  /** Called with the files that were refused (wrong type, too big, over the limit). */
  onReject?: (rejections: FileRejection[]) => void;
  /** Same syntax as <input accept>: ".pdf,.docx" or "image/*". */
  accept?: string;
  /** Allow several files. Default false: a new pick replaces the old file. */
  multiple?: boolean;
  /** Largest file, in bytes. */
  maxSize?: number;
  /** Most files in the list (with `multiple`). */
  maxFiles?: number;
  disabled?: boolean;
  /** Name for the real file input, so the files submit with a surrounding form. */
  name?: string;
  /** The line in the drop target. Default "Click to upload or drag and drop". */
  title?: ReactNode;
  /** The rules under the title. Default: built from `accept`, `maxSize` and `maxFiles`. `null` hides it. */
  rules?: ReactNode;
  /** Icon in the drop target. Default `upload`. */
  icon?: IconName;
  /** `compact` is a single row, for avatars and small forms. Default `default`. */
  variant?: 'default' | 'compact';
  /** Replace the whole content of the drop target. */
  children?: ReactNode;
  /** Show the list of picked files under the target. Default true. */
  showList?: boolean;
  /** Image thumbnails in the list. Default true. */
  previews?: boolean;
  /** Per-file upload state: a progress bar, "Uploaded" or an error message. */
  fileStatus?: (file: File) => FileStatusInfo | undefined;
  /** Extra content under a file's name, e.g. a retry button. */
  renderFileExtra?: (file: File) => ReactNode;
  /** Accessible name of a row's remove button. Default "Remove {name}". */
  removeLabel?: (file: File) => string;
  /** Class for the drop target itself. `className` goes on the outer wrapper. */
  zoneClassName?: string;
}

function hasFiles(e: DragEvent) {
  return Array.from(e.dataTransfer?.types ?? []).includes('Files');
}

function autoRules(accept: string | undefined, maxSize: number | undefined, maxFiles: number | undefined, multiple: boolean) {
  const parts: string[] = [];
  const types = describeAccept(accept);
  if (types) parts.push(types);
  if (maxSize !== undefined) parts.push(multiple ? `up to ${formatBytes(maxSize)} each` : `up to ${formatBytes(maxSize)}`);
  if (multiple && maxFiles !== undefined) parts.push(`max ${maxFiles} ${maxFiles === 1 ? 'file' : 'files'}`);
  return parts.length ? parts.join(' · ') : null;
}

/**
 * FileDropzone — a drop target with a real <input type="file"> behind it, validation
 * (type, size, count) with clear error rows, and a list of picked files with thumbnails,
 * progress and remove buttons. It never uploads: use `onFilesChange` and feed progress back
 * through `fileStatus`. Inside a <Field> it picks up the id, aria-describedby and disabled state.
 */
export const FileDropzone = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, FileDropzoneProps>(function FileDropzone(
  {
    value: valueProp,
    defaultValue,
    onFilesChange,
    onReject,
    accept,
    multiple = false,
    maxSize,
    maxFiles,
    disabled,
    name,
    title,
    rules: rulesProp,
    icon = 'upload',
    variant = 'default',
    children,
    showList = true,
    previews = true,
    fileStatus,
    renderFileExtra,
    removeLabel = (file) => `Remove ${file.name}`,
    zoneClassName,
    className,
    id,
    ...props
  },
  ref,
) {
  const rules = rulesProp === undefined ? autoRules(accept, maxSize, maxFiles, multiple) : rulesProp;
  const titleId = useId();
  const rulesId = useId();
  const control = useFieldControl(
    { id, disabled, 'aria-describedby': props['aria-describedby'] },
    rules !== null && rules !== false && children === undefined ? rulesId : null,
  );
  const isDisabled = !!control.disabled;

  const [files, setFiles] = useControllableState<File[]>({
    value: valueProp,
    defaultValue: defaultValue ?? [],
    onChange: onFilesChange,
  });
  const filesRef = useRef(files);
  filesRef.current = files;
  const [rejections, setRejections] = useState<FileRejection[]>([]);
  const [dragging, setDragging] = useState(false);
  const dragDepth = useRef(0);
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const zoneRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  /** Mirror the list into the real input so a surrounding form submits it. */
  const syncInput = (list: File[]) => {
    const el = inputRef.current;
    if (!el || typeof DataTransfer === 'undefined') return;
    try {
      const transfer = new DataTransfer();
      list.forEach((f) => transfer.items.add(f));
      el.files = transfer.files;
    } catch {
      /* older browsers: the input keeps the last pick */
    }
  };
  useEffect(() => {
    if (name) syncInput(files);
  }, [files, name]);

  const handleFiles = (picked: File[]) => {
    if (isDisabled || !picked.length) return;
    const result = validateFiles(picked, filesRef.current, { accept, maxSize, maxFiles, multiple });
    setRejections(result.rejected);
    if (result.rejected.length) onReject?.(result.rejected);
    if (result.added.length) {
      filesRef.current = result.next;
      setFiles(result.next);
    }
  };

  const handleInput = (e: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    handleFiles(Array.from(e.target.files ?? []));
    // Reset so picking the same file again still fires `change`
    if (name) syncInput(filesRef.current);
    else e.target.value = '';
  };

  const openPicker = () => {
    if (!isDisabled) inputRef.current?.click();
  };

  const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (e.target !== e.currentTarget) return;
    if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
      e.preventDefault();
      openPicker();
    }
  };

  const onDragEnter = (e: DragEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (!hasFiles(e)) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    dragDepth.current += 1;
    if (!isDisabled) setDragging(true);
  };
  const onDragOver = (e: DragEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (!hasFiles(e)) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    e.dataTransfer.dropEffect = isDisabled ? 'none' : 'copy';
  };
  const onDragLeave = (e: DragEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (!hasFiles(e)) return;
    dragDepth.current = Math.max(0, dragDepth.current - 1);
    if (dragDepth.current === 0) setDragging(false);
  };
  const onDrop = (e: DragEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (!hasFiles(e)) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    dragDepth.current = 0;
    setDragging(false);
    handleFiles(Array.from(e.dataTransfer.files));
  };

  const remove = (file: File) => {
    const next = filesRef.current.filter((f) => f !== file);
    filesRef.current = next;
    setFiles(next);
    setRejections([]);
    // The row with the focused button is about to disappear
    zoneRef.current?.focus();
  };

  return (
    <div ref={ref} className={cn('ui-file-dropzone', className)} {...props} aria-describedby={undefined}>
      <div
        ref={zoneRef}
        role="button"
        tabIndex={isDisabled ? -1 : 0}
        className={cn('ui-file-dropzone-zone', variant === 'compact' && 'ui-file-dropzone-compact', zoneClassName)}
        aria-labelledby={children === undefined ? titleId : undefined}
        aria-describedby={control['aria-describedby']}
        aria-disabled={isDisabled || undefined}
        data-dragging={dragging ? '' : undefined}
        data-disabled={isDisabled ? '' : undefined}
        data-invalid={control['aria-invalid'] ? '' : undefined}
        onClick={openPicker}
        onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
        onDragEnter={onDragEnter}
        onDragOver={onDragOver}
        onDragLeave={onDragLeave}
        onDrop={onDrop}
      >
        {children ?? (
          <>
            <span className="ui-file-dropzone-icon" aria-hidden="true">
              <Icon name={icon} size={20} />
            </span>
            <span className="ui-file-dropzone-text">
              <span id={titleId} className="ui-file-dropzone-title">
                {title ?? (
                  <>
                    <span className="ui-file-dropzone-link">Click to upload</span> or drag and drop
                  </>
                )}
              </span>
              {rules !== null && rules !== false && (
                <span id={rulesId} className="ui-file-dropzone-rules">
                  {rules}
                </span>
              )}
            </span>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
      <input
        ref={inputRef}
        id={control.id}
        type="file"
        className="ui-file-dropzone-input"
        tabIndex={-1}
        aria-hidden="true"
        accept={accept}
        multiple={multiple}
        name={name}
        disabled={isDisabled}
        onChange={handleInput}
      />

      {rejections.length > 0 && (
        <ul role="alert" className="ui-file-errors">
          {rejections.map((r, i) => (
            <li key={`${fileKey(r.file)}-${r.code}-${i}`} className="ui-file-error">
              <Icon name="circle-alert" size={16} />
              <span className="ui-file-error-text">{r.message}</span>
              <button
                type="button"
                className="ui-file-row-remove"
                aria-label="Dismiss error"
                onClick={() => setRejections((list) => list.filter((x) => x !== r))}
              >
                <Icon name="x" size={14} />
              </button>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}

      {showList && files.length > 0 && (
        <ul className="ui-file-list" aria-label="Selected files">
          {files.map((file) => (
            <FileRow
              key={fileKey(file)}
              file={file}
              info={fileStatus?.(file)}
              previews={previews}
              extra={renderFileExtra?.(file)}
              removeLabel={removeLabel(file)}
              disabled={isDisabled}
              onRemove={() => remove(file)}
            />
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
    </div>
  );
});
```

### `ui/components/file-dropzone/file-row.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import { useEffect, useState, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { Icon } from '../../icons/icon';
import { Progress } from '../progress/progress';
import { formatBytes } from './file-utils';
import type { FileStatusInfo } from './types';

/** An object URL for `file` that is revoked when the file changes or the row unmounts. */
function useObjectUrl(file: File, enabled: boolean): string | null {
  const [url, setUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!enabled || typeof URL === 'undefined' || typeof URL.createObjectURL !== 'function') {
      setUrl(null);
      return;
    }
    const next = URL.createObjectURL(file);
    setUrl(next);
    return () => URL.revokeObjectURL(next);
  }, [file, enabled]);
  return url;
}

export interface FileRowProps {
  file: File;
  info?: FileStatusInfo;
  /** Show an image thumbnail for image files. */
  previews: boolean;
  /** Extra content under the file name (a retry button, a link). */
  extra?: ReactNode;
  removeLabel: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
  onRemove: () => void;
}

/** One picked file: thumbnail or type icon, name, size, status, optional progress, remove button. */
export function FileRow({ file, info, previews, extra, removeLabel, disabled, onRemove }: FileRowProps) {
  const isImage = file.type.startsWith('image/');
  const url = useObjectUrl(file, previews && isImage);
  const status = info?.status ?? 'idle';
  const pct = info?.progress === undefined ? undefined : Math.min(100, Math.max(0, Math.round(info.progress)));
  const size = formatBytes(file.size);

  const meta =
    status === 'uploading'
      ? `${size} · ${pct === undefined ? 'Uploading…' : `${pct}%`}`
      : status === 'success'
        ? `${size} · Uploaded`
        : status === 'error'
          ? (info?.message ?? 'Upload failed')
          : size;

  return (
    <li className="ui-file-row" data-status={status}>
      <span className="ui-file-row-thumb" aria-hidden="true">
        {url ? <img src={url} alt="" draggable={false} /> : <Icon name={isImage ? 'image' : 'file'} size={18} />}
      </span>
      <span className="ui-file-row-body">
        <span className="ui-file-row-name" title={file.name}>
          {file.name}
        </span>
        <span className="ui-file-row-meta" data-tone={status === 'error' ? 'error' : undefined}>
          {meta}
        </span>
        {status === 'uploading' && (
          <Progress
            size="sm"
            value={pct ?? null}
            aria-label={`Uploading ${file.name}`}
            getValueText={(v) => `${Math.round(v)}% uploaded`}
          />
        )}
        {extra}
      </span>
      {status === 'success' && <Icon name="circle-check" size={18} className="ui-file-row-status" data-tone="success" />}
      {status === 'error' && <Icon name="circle-alert" size={18} className="ui-file-row-status" data-tone="error" />}
      <button type="button" className="ui-file-row-remove" aria-label={removeLabel} disabled={disabled} onClick={onRemove}>
        <Icon name="x" size={16} />
      </button>
    </li>
  );
}
```

### `ui/components/file-dropzone/file-utils.ts`

```ts
export type FileRejectionCode = 'invalid-type' | 'too-large' | 'too-many';

export interface FileRejection {
  /** The file that was refused. For `too-many` it is the first file over the limit. */
  file: File;
  code: FileRejectionCode;
  /** Ready to show: names the file and the rule it broke. */
  message: string;
}

export interface ValidateOptions {
  /** Same syntax as <input accept>: ".pdf,image/*,application/zip". */
  accept?: string;
  /** Bytes. */
  maxSize?: number;
  maxFiles?: number;
  /** More than one file at a time. Default false: a new pick replaces the old file. */
  multiple?: boolean;
}

/** Stable identity of a picked file. */
export function fileKey(file: File): string {
  return `${file.name}:${file.size}:${file.lastModified}`;
}

/** 0 B, 840 B, 1.5 KB, 12 MB, 1.2 GB. */
export function formatBytes(bytes: number): string {
  if (!Number.isFinite(bytes) || bytes <= 0) return '0 B';
  const units = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB', 'TB'];
  const i = Math.min(Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(1024)), units.length - 1);
  const value = bytes / 1024 ** i;
  const text = i === 0 || value >= 100 ? String(Math.round(value)) : value.toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, '');
  return `${text} ${units[i]}`;
}

function acceptTokens(accept: string | undefined): string[] {
  return (accept ?? '')
    .split(',')
    .map((t) => t.trim().toLowerCase())
    .filter(Boolean);
}

/** Does `file` match an <input accept> string? No `accept` means everything does. */
export function matchesAccept(file: Pick<File, 'name' | 'type'>, accept?: string): boolean {
  const tokens = acceptTokens(accept);
  if (!tokens.length) return true;
  const name = file.name.toLowerCase();
  const type = file.type.toLowerCase();
  return tokens.some((token) => {
    if (token.startsWith('.')) return name.endsWith(token);
    if (token.endsWith('/*')) return type.startsWith(token.slice(0, -1));
    return type === token;
  });
}

/** "image/*, .pdf, application/zip" becomes "Images, PDF or ZIP". */
export function describeAccept(accept?: string): string {
  const labels = acceptTokens(accept).map((token) => {
    if (token.startsWith('.')) return token.slice(1).toUpperCase();
    if (token === 'image/*') return 'Images';
    if (token === 'video/*') return 'Videos';
    if (token === 'audio/*') return 'Audio files';
    if (token === 'text/*') return 'Text files';
    const subtype = token.split('/')[1] ?? token;
    return subtype.split('+')[0]!.split('.').pop()!.toUpperCase();
  });
  const unique = Array.from(new Set(labels));
  if (unique.length <= 1) return unique[0] ?? '';
  return `${unique.slice(0, -1).join(', ')} or ${unique[unique.length - 1]}`;
}

/**
 * Check a pick against the rules. Returns the new list, what was added and one rejection per
 * broken rule (overflow past `maxFiles` is reported once). In single mode the new file replaces
 * the old one; if nothing valid was picked the old one stays. Files already in the list are skipped.
 */
export function validateFiles(
  incoming: File[],
  current: File[],
  { accept, maxSize, maxFiles, multiple = false }: ValidateOptions = {},
): { next: File[]; added: File[]; rejected: FileRejection[] } {
  const limit = multiple ? (maxFiles ?? Infinity) : 1;
  const list = multiple ? current.slice() : [];
  const added: File[] = [];
  const rejected: FileRejection[] = [];
  const overflow: File[] = [];

  for (const file of incoming) {
    if (multiple && list.some((f) => fileKey(f) === fileKey(file))) continue;
    if (!matchesAccept(file, accept)) {
      const allowed = describeAccept(accept);
      rejected.push({
        file,
        code: 'invalid-type',
        message: `${file.name} isn't an accepted file type${allowed ? `. Use ${allowed}.` : '.'}`,
      });
      continue;
    }
    if (maxSize !== undefined && file.size > maxSize) {
      rejected.push({
        file,
        code: 'too-large',
        message: `${file.name} is ${formatBytes(file.size)}. The limit is ${formatBytes(maxSize)}.`,
      });
      continue;
    }
    if (list.length >= limit) {
      overflow.push(file);
      continue;
    }
    list.push(file);
    added.push(file);
  }

  if (overflow.length) {
    const rule = !multiple ? 'Only one file is allowed.' : `The limit is ${limit} ${limit === 1 ? 'file' : 'files'}.`;
    rejected.push({
      file: overflow[0]!,
      code: 'too-many',
      message: overflow.length === 1 ? `${overflow[0]!.name} was not added. ${rule}` : `${overflow.length} files were not added. ${rule}`,
    });
  }

  return { next: !multiple && !added.length ? current.slice() : list, added, rejected };
}
```

```ts
  status?: FileStatus;
  /** 0 to 100, shown as a progress bar while `status` is `uploading`. Leave out for an unknown duration. */
```

### `ui/hooks/use-controllable-state.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from 'react';

/**
 * State that can be controlled (`value` + `onChange`) or uncontrolled
 * (`defaultValue`). Every stateful component uses this so the two modes
 * behave identically.
 */
export function useControllableState<T>({
  value,
  defaultValue,
  onChange,
}: {
  value?: T;
  defaultValue: T;
  onChange?: (value: T) => void;
}): [T, (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => void] {
  const [internal, setInternal] = useState<T>(defaultValue);
  const controlled = value !== undefined;
  const current = controlled ? (value as T) : internal;
  const currentRef = useRef(current);
  currentRef.current = current;
  const onChangeRef = useRef(onChange);
  onChangeRef.current = onChange;

  const setValue = useCallback(
    (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => {
      const resolved = typeof next === 'function' ? (next as (prev: T) => T)(currentRef.current) : next;
      if (Object.is(resolved, currentRef.current)) return;
      currentRef.current = resolved;
      if (!controlled) setInternal(resolved);
      onChangeRef.current?.(resolved);
    },
    [controlled],
  );

  return [current, setValue];
}
```

### `ui/icons/icon.tsx`

```tsx
import { forwardRef, type SVGProps } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../lib/cn';
import { iconPaths, type IconName } from './paths';

export interface IconProps extends Omit<SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>, 'ref'> {
  /** Icon shape. */
  name: IconName;
  /** Pixel size (width and height). Default 16. */
  size?: number | string;
  /** Stroke width. Default 1.75. */
  strokeWidth?: number;
  /** Accessible label. Without it the icon is decorative (aria-hidden). */
  label?: string;
}

/**
 * Built-in stroke icon. Inherits `currentColor`.
 *   <Icon name="check" />   <Icon name="search" size={20} label="Search" />
 * Server Component–safe.
 */
export const Icon = forwardRef<SVGSVGElement, IconProps>(function Icon(
  { name, size = 16, strokeWidth = 1.75, label, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return (
    <svg
      ref={ref}
      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      width={size}
      height={size}
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth={strokeWidth}
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      aria-hidden={label ? undefined : true}
      aria-label={label}
      role={label ? 'img' : undefined}
      focusable="false"
      className={cn('ui-icon', className)}
      // Static, library-owned SVG markup — never user input.
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: iconPaths[name] }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

export { iconPaths, type IconName };
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `ui/styles/components/file-dropzone.css`

```css
/* File dropzone -----------------------------------------------------------
   <div class="ui-file-dropzone">
     <div class="ui-file-dropzone-zone [ui-file-dropzone-compact]" role="button" tabindex="0"
          data-dragging data-disabled data-invalid>
       <span class="ui-file-dropzone-icon">…</span>
       <span class="ui-file-dropzone-text">
         <span class="ui-file-dropzone-title"><span class="ui-file-dropzone-link">…</span></span>
         <span class="ui-file-dropzone-rules">PDF, DOCX · up to 10 MB each</span>
       </span>
     </div>
     <input class="ui-file-dropzone-input" type="file" aria-hidden>      visually hidden
     <ul class="ui-file-errors" role="alert"><li class="ui-file-error">…</li></ul>
     <ul class="ui-file-list"><li class="ui-file-row" data-status="idle|uploading|success|error">
        .ui-file-row-thumb  .ui-file-row-body > .ui-file-row-name + .ui-file-row-meta + progress
        .ui-file-row-status  .ui-file-row-remove </li></ul>
   </div>
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

@layer components {
  .ui-file-dropzone {
    position: relative;
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.75rem;
    width: 100%;
    min-width: 0;
  }

  /* The real file input stays in the DOM (and in forms) but is never seen or tabbed to */
  .ui-file-dropzone-input {
    position: absolute;
    width: 1px;
    height: 1px;
    margin: -1px;
    padding: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    clip-path: inset(50%);
    border: 0;
    opacity: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  /* ---- Drop target ---------------------------------------------------- */
  .ui-file-dropzone-zone {
    --ui-dz-border: var(--ui-border-strong);
    --ui-dz-bg: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-surface-muted) 45%, transparent);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 0.75rem;
    min-height: 9rem;
    padding: 1.5rem 1.25rem;
    border: 1.5px dashed var(--ui-dz-border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    background-color: var(--ui-dz-bg);
    color: var(--ui-foreground);
    text-align: center;
    cursor: pointer;
    outline: none;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    transition:
      border-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      background-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      box-shadow var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      transform var(--ui-spring-snappy-duration) var(--ui-spring-snappy);
  }
  .ui-file-dropzone-zone:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 45%, transparent); --ui-dz-border: var(--ui-ring); }
  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ui-file-dropzone-zone:hover:not([data-disabled], [data-dragging]) {
      --ui-dz-border: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-border-strong) 50%, var(--ui-foreground));
      --ui-dz-bg: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-surface-muted) 80%, transparent);
    }
  }

  /* Something is being dragged over: primary tint and a soft scale */
  .ui-file-dropzone-zone[data-dragging] {
    --ui-dz-border: var(--ui-primary);
    --ui-dz-bg: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-primary) 7%, transparent);
    transform: scale(1.01);
  }
  .ui-file-dropzone-zone[data-invalid] { --ui-dz-border: var(--ui-destructive); }
  .ui-file-dropzone-zone[data-disabled] { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

  .ui-file-dropzone-icon {
    display: inline-flex;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 2.5rem;
    height: 2.5rem;
    border-radius: 9999px;
    background-color: var(--ui-surface-muted);
    color: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
    transition:
      background-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      transform var(--ui-spring-snappy-duration) var(--ui-spring-snappy);
  }
  .ui-file-dropzone-zone[data-dragging] .ui-file-dropzone-icon {
    background-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-primary) 14%, transparent);
    color: var(--ui-primary-text);
    transform: translateY(-2px);
  }

  .ui-file-dropzone-text { display: grid; gap: 0.25rem; min-width: 0; }
  .ui-file-dropzone-title { font-size: var(--text-base); font-weight: 500; }
  .ui-file-dropzone-link { color: var(--ui-primary-text); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; }
  .ui-file-dropzone-rules { color: var(--ui-muted-foreground); font-size: var(--text-sm); }

  /* Compact: one row */
  .ui-file-dropzone-compact {
    flex-direction: row;
    justify-content: flex-start;
    min-height: 0;
    padding: 0.875rem 1rem;
    text-align: start;
  }

  /* ---- Error rows ----------------------------------------------------- */
  .ui-file-errors { display: grid; gap: 0.375rem; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
  .ui-file-error {
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    padding: 0.5rem 0.5rem 0.5rem 0.75rem;
    border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-destructive) 24%, transparent);
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    background-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-destructive) 8%, transparent);
    color: var(--ui-destructive-text);
    font-size: var(--text-sm);
    animation: ui-rise-in var(--ui-duration) var(--ui-ease-out) both;
  }
  .ui-file-error > svg { flex-shrink: 0; margin-top: 0.125rem; }
  .ui-file-error-text { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

  /* ---- File rows ------------------------------------------------------ */
  .ui-file-list { display: grid; gap: 0.5rem; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
  .ui-file-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.75rem;
    min-width: 0;
    padding: 0.625rem 0.5rem 0.625rem 0.625rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--ui-border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    background-color: var(--ui-surface);
    color: var(--ui-surface-foreground);
    animation: ui-rise-in var(--ui-duration) var(--ui-ease-out) both;
  }
  .ui-file-row[data-status="error"] { border-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-destructive) 40%, var(--ui-border)); }

  .ui-file-row-thumb {
    display: inline-flex;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 2.5rem;
    height: 2.5rem;
    overflow: hidden;
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    background-color: var(--ui-surface-muted);
    color: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
  }
  .ui-file-row-thumb > img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; }

  .ui-file-row-body { display: grid; flex: 1 1 auto; gap: 0.25rem; min-width: 0; }
  .ui-file-row-name { overflow: hidden; font-size: var(--text-base); font-weight: 500; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
  .ui-file-row-meta { color: var(--ui-muted-foreground); font-size: var(--text-xs); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
  .ui-file-row-meta[data-tone="error"] { color: var(--ui-destructive-text); }

  .ui-file-row-status { flex-shrink: 0; }
  .ui-file-row-status[data-tone="success"] { color: var(--ui-success-text); }
  .ui-file-row-status[data-tone="error"] { color: var(--ui-destructive-text); }

  /* Remove / dismiss: a quiet icon button */
  .ui-file-row-remove {
    display: inline-flex;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 2rem;
    height: 2rem;
    padding: 0;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
    cursor: pointer;
    outline: none;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    transition:
      background-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      box-shadow var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      transform var(--ui-spring-snappy-duration) var(--ui-spring-snappy);
  }
  .ui-file-error .ui-file-row-remove { width: 1.5rem; height: 1.5rem; color: inherit; }
  .ui-file-row-remove > svg { pointer-events: none; }
  .ui-file-row-remove:active:not(:disabled) { transform: scale(0.94); }
  .ui-file-row-remove:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 45%, transparent); }
  .ui-file-row-remove:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.5; }
  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ui-file-row-remove:hover:not(:disabled) { background-color: var(--ui-accent); color: var(--ui-accent-foreground); }
  }

  /* Coarse pointers get a 44px hit area on the remove button */
  @media (pointer: coarse) {
    .ui-file-row-remove { width: 2.75rem; height: 2.75rem; }
    .ui-file-error .ui-file-row-remove { width: 2.75rem; height: 2.75rem; margin-block: -0.75rem; }
  }
}
```

## Usage

**Documents with progress** — from the docs (`apps/docs/examples/file-dropzone/documents.tsx`), imports rewritten to `@/ui/...`:

```tsx
'use client';

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Field, Label } from '@/ui/components/field';
import { FileDropzone, fileKey } from '@/ui/components/file-dropzone';

/** Fakes an upload: progress climbs every 250ms until the file is "uploaded". */
export default function FileDropzoneDocuments() {
  const [files, setFiles] = useState<File[]>([]);
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState<Record<string, number>>({});
  const timers = useRef(new Map<string, ReturnType<typeof setInterval>>());

  useEffect(() => {
    const keys = new Set(files.map(fileKey));
    for (const [key, timer] of timers.current) {
      if (!keys.has(key)) {
        clearInterval(timer);
        timers.current.delete(key);
      }
    }
    for (const file of files) {
      const key = fileKey(file);
      if (timers.current.has(key)) continue;
      let value = 0;
      const speed = 6 + (file.size % 7);
      const timer = setInterval(() => {
        value = Math.min(100, value + speed);
        setProgress((p) => ({ ...p, [key]: value }));
        if (value >= 100) clearInterval(timer);
      }, 250);
      timers.current.set(key, timer);
    }
  }, [files]);

  useEffect(
    () => () => {
      timers.current.forEach((timer) => clearInterval(timer));
    },
    [],
  );

  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-lg">
      <Field>
        <Label>Contracts and invoices</Label>
        <FileDropzone
          multiple
          accept=".pdf,.docx,.xlsx"
          maxSize={10 * 1024 * 1024}
          maxFiles={5}
          value={files}
          onFilesChange={setFiles}
          fileStatus={(file) => {
            const value = progress[fileKey(file)] ?? 0;
            return value >= 100 ? { status: 'success' } : { status: 'uploading', progress: value };
          }}
        />
      </Field>
    </div>
  );
}
```
